query:
UPDATE bear_task_run_state
            SET status = 'done',
                result_summary = COALESCE(NULLIF(result_summary, ''), 'All child tasks are terminal.'),
                finished_at = COALESCE(finished_at, NOW()),
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE run_id = $1 AND task_id = $2 AND status NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled')
